parts.html: The K-26 kitchen model brings warm brown tones and a wood-effect finish into a contemporary kitchen interior. Its coordinated cabinetry creates a welcoming atmosphere while maintaining the clean lines and straightforward organization of modern kitchen furniture.

The model’s defining visual feature is its wood-look decor. The brown finish can complement light walls, neutral grey and beige surfaces, ceramic tile, and stone-effect materials. It can also help connect the kitchen with other wood-textured elements in the room.

With a linear length of 3.7 meters, K-26 arranges the main kitchen functions along one wall. Its straight-line configuration helps preserve floor space for dining and circulation, making the model suitable for apartments, private homes, and open-plan kitchen-living interiors.

The positions of the sink, hob, refrigerator, and other built-in appliances can be determined during individual planning. Cabinet dimensions and internal storage are adapted to the room layout, service connections, and the client’s requirements.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard. Their coordinated wood-effect finish gives the kitchen the appearance of a natural texture without using solid timber in the standard specification. The cabinet structure is made from 18 mm laminated particleboard, while the countertop is chipboard-based.

The standard K-26 model does not include a separate kitchen island, pull-out cargo storage, or lift mechanisms. Its work surfaces and storage are organized within the main straight-line furniture composition.

Hinged cabinet doors use Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close. Pull-out elements are fitted with Muller telescopic runners without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included in the standard configuration.

K-26 can also be customized beyond its standard materials and hardware. Upon request, the kitchen can be equipped with more advanced furniture fittings, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional functional storage systems. It can also be manufactured using alternative materials, from budget-friendly options to premium finishes. The final selection depends on the client’s practical needs, room dimensions, preferences, and project budget.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close
Drawer runners: Muller telescopic runners without soft-close
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-26 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, plumbing and electrical connections, and built-in appliance requirements. Cabinet sizes, front and countertop materials, hardware, and internal storage can be selected to suit the project.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances can also be selected upon request.
